index.html.title: Books by Dr. Connor Robertson | Compare Business Books
index.html.description: Compare Dr. Connor Robertson’s business acquisition, ownership and sales books. Explore individual titles and choose the reading that matches your next decision.
index.html.heading: Find a book for the decision in front of you
index.html.body:
Compare Buying Wealth for business ownership and acquisition thinking, Creative Acquisitions for deal-structure questions, and The 7 Minute Phone Call for sales conversations.

Read each title’s overview before choosing a format. If you are evaluating a live business, use the live-deal reading guide to separate ideas from evidence you still need to verify.
